content_sections.heading: About the College
content_sections.text: Tatyasaheb Kore Shikshanshastra Mahavidyalaya is a B.Ed college at Warananagar, Tal. Panhala, Dist. Kolhapur, Maharashtra, with PIN 416 113. The notice describes it as affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur, and as permanently non granted. The notice is signed by the President of Shree Warana Vibhag Shikshan Mandal, Warananagar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Reserved category candidates are advised to send a copy of their application to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur, 416004 (Room No. 138). Applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. The notice prints no pay amount. For the SC/ST category, a relaxation of 5% is provided, from 55% to 50% of the marks at the Master's degree level. Reservation of SC/ST categories is interchangeable as per Govt. GR dated 05.12.1994. PWD, Woman, Orphans and Sports Person reservation applies as per Government Resolution and Circulars issued from time to time. Reserved category candidates outside the State of Maharashtra will be treated as Open Category candidates. Candidates should check the official notification and the rules of Shivaji University, Kolhapur for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor posts are vacant at Tatyasaheb Kore Shikshanshastra Mahavidyalaya?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts: 2 in Perspective in Education, and 1 each in Pedagogy Subject Mathematics, Social Sciences and Languages.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be made within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement, which is about 27 November 2026 counted from the notice date of 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. SC/ST candidates get a relaxation from 55% to 50% marks at the Master's degree level.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply giving full particulars to the undersigned, the President of Shree Warana Vibhag Shikshan Mandal, Warananagar, within 15 days of publication. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q5. Which post has a reserved vacancy?
faq.answer: Perspective in Education has 2 posts, of which 1 is Open and 1 is reserved for SC. The three Pedagogy Subject posts are Open.

faq.question: Q6. What should reserved category candidates do additionally?
faq.answer: They should produce the Caste Validity Certificate and are advised to send a copy of their application to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur, 416004 (Room No. 138).

faq.question: Q7. How are reserved category candidates from outside Maharashtra treated?
faq.answer: Reserved category candidates outside the State of Maharashtra will be treated as Open Category candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates already in service apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q9. Is this recruitment subject to any court decision?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment procedure is subject to the decision of Hon. Bombay High Court, Aurangabad Bench on writ petition No. 12051/2015.
